premises.text: Bicycle theft is a large worldwide problem with major insurance damage
premises.evidence_span: Bicycle theft is a huge problem worldwide, with over 5.7 billion euros of stolen bicycles every year

premises.text: Existing keyless locks and tracking devices have not been integrated into one smart lock
premises.evidence_span: There are some keyless locks, and then there are some tracking devices. But they haven't been integrated really

premises.text: A truly smart lock needs alarm, security, GPS trackability, and a keyless mechanism
premises.evidence_span: It has to have an alarm. It has to be secure. And it has to be GPS trackable

premises.text: Multi-sensor suite detects saw/drill, impact, torch/cold spray, light intrusion, and cable cuts
Built-in GPS tracker locates the bike if stolen
premises.evidence_span: if your bicycle actually gets stolen, we have a tracker, a GPS tracker that no other bicycle lock has

premises.text: App enables alarm, push/email/SMS alerts, and locates the lock
premises.evidence_span: if my thief tries to tamper with it, it switches on the alarm. And I will shortly get a push notification

premises.text: Owners can share or rent bikes (and rent locks) for connected mobility without city infrastructure
premises.evidence_span: if you want to make money with your bike, you can rent your bike out to whoever you want

value.text: Secure bikes with a keyless smart lock that alarms, tracks, and enables sharing
value.evidence_span: how can we make a truly smart lock that we could use

causal_links.evidence_span: Bicycle theft is a huge problem worldwide
we can share bikes easily with anyone that we want

notes: Singleton D3 retained: sharing/rental is presented as a distinct value path beyond theft prevention. Sensor list treated as one anti-tamper mechanism (P4).
